facts.text: Drop Dead Ned, the inn's killer who carries a little killer wasp, is hired by the party for a 100 gold fee and accompanies them in the Barrow Mound as a scout and killer.
Ned pays the party 10 gold each time they let him murder somebody, provided he can do whatever he wants with the body.
Ned offers 5 gold per goblin body for the three dead goblins in the Barrow Mound's lower corridor, if the party gives him the bodies.
The Free Goblin Society goblins would not want their dead compatriots defiled, so giving the goblin bodies to Ned means sneaking them past the goblins.
